items.q: this is John Zami. This is John Zami right there on Robinson and Columbus. That's another hall.

ctx.x: Yes, I remember that. In those days, when he was living there, I don't remember any balls

or any dances. No, they never had no dances there. They'd have a little wedding like that night, didn't they? They'd have banquets and meetings and things like that, like they have down there right there at this hall down there on Robinson. Robinson and, what's his name, this is John Zami.
